scope: Fresh local CHO ingestion baseline, workflow contracts and exploratory four-case current-agent pilot. No deployment or production validation.

reasoning.diagnostic_ai_audit_scope: Independent AI inspection of source CSVs and returned answers; not human review or a replacement for frozen original grades.

cho_ingestion.scope: Real CHO cultivation measurements from Zenodo record 20829178 (CC BY 4.0), repackaged as fictional CMO deliveries. Company names, layouts, sample IDs and certificates are invented. Injected defects are artificial.

limits: Only four newly authored agent cases, one attempt each, with same-model automated judging; neither expert-reviewed nor externally held out.
Descriptive source identifiers leak task-category hints; exact answers were not seeded as agent instructions.
Public CHO laboratory values are authentic; CMO companies, forms, IDs, inventories and defects are constructed.
The three ingestion evaluation packages were held out from the mapping calibration in this run; they are existing repository fixtures and are not an untouched external test set.
Extraction and regression scores do not measure causal diagnosis, downstream impact, approval execution, real user effort or manufacturing qualification.
All three ingestion packages remain blocked from verified publication. No review or verification flags were fabricated.
No real-data numerical direct-task resolution was scored because those packages did not pass the verification gate. The direct replay is two synthetic contract tasks repeated three times.
No official PRONTO, DABstep, BIRD or RCAEval campaign ran; their adapters remain future work.
Timing is local service/application time, not browser/deployment/network-load SLO evidence. There is no paired Parker-query speedup measurement.
Provider cost is a conservative token estimate, not a reconciled invoice; infrastructure and human review costs remain unmeasured.
next_priorities: Use deterministic discovery and row-level retrieval for procedural work, with source scope and revisions preserved.
Preserve paging/truncation state through the model context and allow required retrieval to complete before finalizing.
Fix CSV-aware numeric grounding and grade the exact evidence visible to the model.
Evaluate useful partial results and explicit review requests without pretending an unresolved delivery is fully verified.
